hypothesis: Local value forwarding and receiver construction connect input changes to issue APIs. The old one-hop argument prior drops these interactions. A bounded source may-dependence prior can allocate review effort more directly.
selection: Stable true-first partition of the complete original source-shape ranking; fixed budgets 8,16,32 per each of17 trials.
evaluation: Freeze complete rankings first. Then compare selected parent identities with the previously complete136-parent audit cohort. Matched audits apply only to their exact frozen prefix programs, not to the newly ranked complete parents.
limitations: This is a development-set prioritization experiment, not a detector.
Only represented local dependencies are tracked. Unknown dispatch, aliasing, guards and effects are not proved.
No validated program can be inferred from ranking or lack of static contradiction.
